criterionRegistry.text: The queue holds only the Language's new and due, unsuspended Pronounce Cards (ord 3) in its Pronunciation decks under the Prefix.
The queue is in FR-30 order: due Cards first, oldest due first, then new Cards in creation order.
The queue read returns the due and new counts and, per Card, its cardId, itemId, reps, Category, Target text and saved Reference audio name.
The Pronunciation screen shows the current Card's Target text and the "N due · M new" chip (aria-label "N due, M new") on phone and iPad layouts.
An empty queue shows "Nothing to practice in <Language>" / "No new or due Pronounce Cards right now." and no Rating buttons.
The first Card is read and shown before the pre-session Sync is requested, with no Sync UI, and a slow pre-session Sync never delays it.
Reference plays the Card's audio from /api/media on tap; a Card without Reference audio shows no Reference control.
A Rating is answered through Anki's scheduler for that Card only, with again/hard/good/easy mapped to ease 1-4 in the adapter.
Tapping Again, Hard, Good or Easy (always enabled in 7.1) submits that Card's Rating with its reps and, once Anki confirms, loads the next Card and updates the chip.
A retried Rating whose reps no longer match Anki's returns success marked alreadyAnswered and sends no second answer (AD-20).
A failed Rating shows "Rating not saved — Anki isn't reachable." with Try again, and the Card stays current and unanswered.
Idempotent session start and end endpoints each request one Sync and never wait for it; requests coalesce to at most one running and one pending Sync (AD-17).
The client sends the session end signal when the review screen unmounts (also on hidden, pagehide via sendBeacon, and an empty queue).
In dev mode (LANGUAGE_LAB_DEV=1) session start and end succeed and request no Sync.
